objects.query: SELECT Id, Name, BillingStreet, BillingCity, BillingPostalCode, BillingCountry, Phone, Website, AccountSource, BillingAddress, Description, Industry, Jigsaw, NumberOfEmployees, Ownership, ParentId, Rating, ShippingAddress, SicDesc, Site, Type, BillingState FROM Account

SELECT Id, FirstName, LastName, Email, Phone, AccountId, BuyerAttributes, ContactSource, Department, Description, DoNotCall, Fax, HasOptedOutOfEmail, Jigsaw, LastCURequestDate, LastCUUpdateDate, LeadSource, MailingAddress, MobilePhone, Name, ReportsToId, Title, Salutation, IsDeleted FROM Contact WHERE CreatedDate = LAST_N_DAYS:7
